caveat: Emulated phones: headless Chrome pages on the same Mac as the host, over loopback. No radio, no router, no phone CPU. This is a best case and does not prove PERF-010 on real Wi-Fi.

method.delay: touch→step: host clock time of the 60 Hz simulation step that applies an input, minus the phone clock time of the touch event (scripted events for bots), mapped to the host clock by the ping/pong offset.
method.clock: ping/pong on the unreliable channel; offset = (t0 + t1)/2 − phone time; the sample with the lowest round trip of the last 16 is used.
method.channels: input: ordered=false, maxRetransmits=0. control: ordered, reliable.
method.iceServers: none (local addresses only; no external service contacted)

PERF-010.measuredOn: loopback, emulated phones, every fixed-60 Hz scenario including the touch-driven one
PERF-010.why: needs real phones on real Wi-Fi

PERF-011.why: no relay run: needs TURN credentials and Randy (README)
